reviewer: fresh agent (Claude Haiku 5.5), given only the skill folder and standalone-review.md; the choco_java standalone-review.json was read for format only

findings.quote: Write each block of constraints as rows, with the comment line taken from the part of the problem it encodes.
findings.why: The required description-derived comment before each constraint block is a convention of the benchmark's model generation, not advice a HiGHS user needs.

findings.quote: Only integer columns that the outputs depend on need no-goods
findings.why: "the outputs" refers to the declared-output contract of a runner that reads named outputs, not to what a standalone program prints.
